data_description.verify_ssl: Disabled by default because many local KentixONE systems use a self-signed certificate. Enable it when the Kentix certificate is trusted by Home Assistant.

data_description.scan_interval: Time between GET /api/systemvalues requests. Default: 60 seconds. Use 60 seconds for older Kentix hardware; modern SiteManagers can usually use 30 seconds. Webhooks additionally trigger immediate refreshes for alarms and switching events.
data_description.manage_webhook: Creates one active, uniquely named webhook in KentixONE and assigns it to every alarm group for all alarms, system alarms, and completed switching operations. Other webhooks are never modified.

init.description: The system-values interval updates alarm groups and MultiSensor measurements together through /api/systemvalues. Automatic webhook management additionally provides immediate refreshes for alarms and switching operations. Inventory is read at most every four hours.
init.title: Kentix options
